sourcedFrom: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) (undated — no copyright line is printed anywhere in this document)
cleanIntro: Springfield’s own field strip for the Echelon. The disassembly lever is interlocked to the magazine and the pistol comes apart WITHOUT a trigger pull — the manual says so in its own words, and it is the one thing that separates this strip from the XD family’s.

steps.title: Check this book is for your pistol
steps.action: This procedure comes from the Echelon manual. Springfield states on its cover that this manual is for Echelon firearms only.
steps.prose: Springfield publishes a separate book per family — XD, XD-S, XD-M, SA-35, 1911, 1911 DS — and they do not share strips. A pistol that looks similar is not covered by this one.
steps.quote: THIS MANUAL IS FOR ECHELON FIREARMS ONLY.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — Cover, safety information panel

steps.title: Eye protection, muzzle safe, finger off
steps.action: Point the firearm in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger, and wear eye protection before anything comes apart.
steps.prose: The Echelon will fire with or without a magazine in it. The magazine coming out is not the gun being empty.
steps.quote: POINT FIREARM IN SAFE DIRECTION WHILE KEEPING FINGER OFF THE TRIGGER.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 1
steps.warn: ALWAYS REMEMBER THE FIREARM IS ABLE TO FIRE WITH OR WITHOUT THE MAGAZINE IN PLACE.

steps.title: Magazine out, firearm unloaded
steps.action: Remove the magazine and unload the firearm.
steps.prose: Magazine first. The disassembly lever will not turn until it is out, so the pistol enforces this order for you.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 2

steps.title: Lock the slide open — and the trick if it fights you
steps.action: Retract the slide and lock it open by pushing up the slide stop lever.
steps.prose: If that is awkward Springfield gives an alternative: put an EMPTY magazine in the magwell, retract fully until it locks, then remove the magazine. Confirm it is empty first or you will load the pistol doing it.
steps.quote: Retract the slide and lock it open by pushing up the slide stop lever
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 3 (printed p.22, per Figure 22-1; this edition prints no page folios; the printed page is the prefix of the figure caption on the same page)

steps.title: Look into the chamber
steps.action: Visually inspect the chamber to confirm the firearm is unloaded.
steps.prose: Eyes on the chamber, not just a hand on the slide. Everything after this depends on it being true.
steps.quote: Visually inspect the chamber to confirm the firearm is unloaded.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 4

steps.title: Disassembly lever down to 6 o’clock
steps.action: Rotate the disassembly lever clockwise to a vertical 6 o’clock position.
steps.prose: Six o’clock, not twelve — the XD and XD-M turn theirs to twelve, and this is the same motion ending in the opposite place. It will not rotate at all until the magazine is out. No trigger pull is required to take an Echelon apart.
steps.quote: ECHELON MODELS HAVE A DISASSEMBLY SYSTEM (SLIDE REMOVAL) WITHOUT TRIGGERING!
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, note above step 1, and step 5 (printed p.22, per Figure 22-2)
steps.warn: Disassembly lever cannot be rotated unless magazine has been removed.

steps.title: Ease the slide off the frame
steps.action: Pull the slide slightly to the rear to release the slide stop lever, grip it firmly and let it move forward slowly until the spring tension is released, then run the complete slide assembly forward and off the frame.
steps.prose: Hold it by the middle. Springfield specifically says not to grip the muzzle end or over the ejection port while you do this.
steps.caution: Slide is under spring tension. Maintain control. Do not grip the slide in the area of the muzzle or ejection port.
steps.quote: Pull the slide slightly to the rear to release the slide stop lever.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 6 (printed p.23, per Figures 23-1 and 23-2)
steps.warn: Do not retract and release the striker allowing it to snap forward as this can damage the striker pin safety.

steps.title: Recoil system out of the slide
steps.action: Remove the recoil system from the slide.
steps.prose: It is a captive assembly, so it comes out as one piece — but it is still a compressed spring. Lift it out, do not let it jump.
steps.caution: Spring is under tension. Maintain control.
steps.quote: Remove the recoil system from the slide
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 7 (printed p.24, per Figure 24-1)

steps.title: Barrel out — strip complete
steps.action: Remove the barrel from the slide.
steps.prose: Frame, slide, barrel, recoil system. That is the whole field strip Springfield publishes for this pistol.
steps.quote: The firearm is now fully field stripped and ready for cleaning.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — FIELD STRIP, step 8 (printed p.24, per Figure 24-2)

deepSteps.title: Field strip first
deepSteps.action: Field strip the pistol before starting, and confirm again that it is completely unloaded — magazine and chamber.
deepSteps.prose: The Central Operating Group is the Echelon’s fire control, removable as a unit. Springfield publishes its removal; that is what makes this a documented deep strip rather than a guess.
deepSteps.quote: The ECHELON has a removable Central Operating Group (COG) assembly that contains the firing mechanism.
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — CENTRAL OPERATING GROUP (COG) REMOVAL, intro and step 1

deepSteps.title: Disassembly lever all the way out
deepSteps.action: Pull the disassembly lever half way out with the tip of your index finger, then rotate it counter-clockwise while pulling outward until the lever comes free.
deepSteps.prose: Counter-clockwise on the way out — the opposite hand of the clockwise quarter-turn that started the field strip.
deepSteps.quote: Remove the disassembly lever half way out by pulling outward with the tip of your index finger
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — CENTRAL OPERATING GROUP (COG) REMOVAL, step 2 (printed p.25, per Figure 25-1)

deepSteps.title: Slide the COG forward
deepSteps.action: Lift the slide stop levers, depress the trigger just enough to deactivate the trigger safety, and slide the COG forward while keeping minimal upward pressure on the slide stop levers. The rear of the COG can then be rotated upwards.
deepSteps.prose: Minimal upward pressure is the operative word — the levers only need to clear their recesses. Check the slide stop lever pin stays correctly oriented as it moves.
deepSteps.quote: Lift the slide stop levers, depress the trigger enough to deactivate the trigger safety and slide the COG forward while maintaining minimal upward pressure on the slide
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — CENTRAL OPERATING GROUP (COG) REMOVAL, step 3 (printed p.25, per Figures 25-2 to 25-4)

deepSteps.title: COG out of the grip module
deepSteps.action: Lift the front part of the COG and at the same time lower the rear part, and remove it from the grip.
deepSteps.prose: Front up, rear down, together. This is where the Echelon stops: the chassis is out, and Springfield draws the line here.
deepSteps.quote: Lift the front part of the COG, and at the same time lower the rear part and remove it from the grip
deepSteps.cite: Springfield Armory Echelon Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual, current support-site edition (no part code printed) — CENTRAL OPERATING GROUP (COG) REMOVAL, step 4 (printed p.25, per Figure 25-5)
deepSteps.warn: Further dismantling is not necessary and should only be done by Springfield, Inc. or a qualified gunsmith.

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Solvent-wet patch through the bore, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Wipe the feed ramp and the barrel exterior
A light pass of oil outside; nothing pooled

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Scrub the breech face and around the extractor
Wipe the striker channel DRY — no oil in an ignition channel

cleaning.name: FRAME & MAGAZINES
tasks: Wipe the magazine bodies dry — no oil where ammunition sits

reassembly: COG back into the grip: tabs at its lower front into the grip opening, depress the trigger enough to clear the trigger safety, rotate the rear down and press rearward until the slide stop levers drop into their recesses.
Position the takedown lever, press inward while twisting it slightly clockwise, then press it flush and rotate it to the vertical position.
Barrel and recoil system back into the slide, slide onto the frame, then rotate the disassembly lever back up.
Rack the slide several times before handling further.
fncheck: With the magazine out and the chamber confirmed empty, rack the slide and confirm the trigger resets, pointed in a safe direction.
